faq_heading: Canyon Springs condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Canyon Springs. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Canyon Springs, Coquitlam: 21 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 24%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 8 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Canyon Springs rose from 20 in June to 21 in September (+5.0%), and 18 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.6% of Coquitlam’s 806 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Canyon Springs?
Canyon Springs also had 10 houses listed and 1 sold in September, against 21 condos and townhomes listed. The Canyon Springs houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Canyon Springs home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

31 condos sold in Canyon Springs with a median price of $530,000 (the middle half sold between $436,250 and $576,125), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 97.6% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $589 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median strata fee of $481 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Canyon Springs?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 21 condos and townhomes listed in Canyon Springs. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Canyon Springs a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Canyon Springs had a sales ratio of 24%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Canyon Springs from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 18 condos and townhomes sold in Canyon Springs over those 4 months, out of 475 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Canyon Springs sell for?
faq.a: 31 condos sold in Canyon Springs between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $530,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Canyon Springs?
faq.a: The median was 19 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.6% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
